name: gradient
title: Gradient Floor / Text
description: 装饰两件：Floor 是页面底部双色光晕（呼吸动画，绝对定位铺底）；Text 是 background-clip 渐变文字（可缓慢流动）。
docs:
- `color / color2 / opacity / height` (string / string / number / number，默认 accent / info / 0.5 / 320)：Floor：双色/不透明度/高度
- `breathing` (boolean，默认 true)：Floor：呼吸动画
- `text / from / to / angle / animated` (string / … / boolean，默认 - / accent / info / 120 / false)：Text：内容与渐变

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, withDefaults } from "vue";
import type { GradientFloorProps } from "./types";

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<GradientFloorProps>(), { breathing: true });

const style = computed(() => ({
  "--va-gf-h": `${props.height ?? 320}px`,
  "--va-gf-x": `${(props.position ?? 0.5) * 100}%`,
  "--va-gf-c1": props.color ?? "var(--va-accent)",
  "--va-gf-c2": props.color2 ?? "var(--va-info)",
  "--va-gf-o": String(props.opacity ?? 0.5),
}));
</script>

<template>
  <div class="va-gfloor" :class="{ 'va-gfloor--breathe': props.breathing }" :style="style" aria-hidden="true" />
</template>

<style>
/* VaGradientFloor — 底部氛围光晕（装饰层，宿主放绝对定位） */

.va-gfloor {
  position: absolute;
  left: -10%;
  right: -10%;
  bottom: calc(var(--va-gf-h, 320px) * -0.55);
  height: var(--va-gf-h, 320px);
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: var(--va-gf-o, 0.5);
  background:
    radial-gradient(60% 100% at var(--va-gf-x, 50%) 100%, var(--va-gf-c1, var(--va-accent)), transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(40% 80% at calc(100% - var(--va-gf-x, 50%)) 100%, var(--va-gf-c2, var(--va-info)), transparent 70%);
  filter: blur(48px);
}

.va-gfloor--breathe {
  animation: va-gf-breathe 7s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes va-gf-breathe {
  0%, 100% { opacity: var(--va-gf-o, 0.5); transform: translateY(0); }
  50% { opacity: calc(var(--va-gf-o, 0.5) * 1.25); transform: translateY(-8px); }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .va-gfloor--breathe { animation: none; }
}
</style>
